title: Powderbird
specs: Founded in 1973 as one of the world’s first helicopter skiing operators
Access to wide-open powder fields, steep chutes, and expansive ridgelines
Professional guide team dedicated to pinnacle experiences
Comfortable skiing black to double black diamond terrain
Ability to ski confidently in variable conditions
Semi-private groups up to 3 guests and 2 guides
Private groups up to 8 guests and 2 guides
includes: Lodging at The Cliff Lodge (multi-day packages)
Access to The Cliff Spa (multi-day packages)
blurb: Powderbird offers guided helicopter skiing and snowboarding trips in Utah's Wasatch Mountains. Guests can choose from single day or multi-day packages including lodging and exclusive amenities. The experience includes skiing varied terrain with professional guides and access to premium resort facilities.
extraNote: Guests matched with groups of similar skill levels or can reserve private helicopter · VIP Snowbird skiing experience with line-cutting privileges if helicopter cannot fly due to weather · Powderbird Heliport in Little Cottonwood Canyon · Winter
